run_model_accel_npg_experiment: run a model accelerated NPG policy optimization experiment with a config file and output directory
run_buffer_size_calculation: run the buffer_size function to compute total transitions across a list of trajectory paths
run_world_model_fitting: run world model fitting on collected state-action-next_state data to learn dynamics and reward
run_npg_policy_update: run natural policy gradient updates using learned world models for model-based reinforcement learning
run_policy_evaluation: run evaluation rollouts of the trained policy in the real environment and log performance metrics
